name: Slovenia: Ljubljana, the Julian Alps and the Adriatic
tagline: A night train to a small country with Alps, karst caves, a Venetian coast and a First World War front line.

access.route: Train: Nightjet Brussels→Vienna (14 h, couchette) then Vienna→Ljubljana (6 h); or via Munich by day
Eurostar→Paris, TGV→Munich or Zürich, then Ljubljana (two days or a night train)

nightsNote: 7–10°C at the Triglav huts, 17°C in Ljubljana
whyNotes: The Alps hiking you love in a range you have not walked: the Julian Alps are limestone, lower, wilder and far cheaper than the western Alps. Ljubljana and Piran give the city days a Habsburg-and-Venetian flavour.
fitNotes: Highest point 2,400 m on the Seven Lakes route, mountains at 20–24°C. Ljubljana reaches 30°C and Bled is crowded; both are kept short. Short distances everywhere: nothing is more than 2 h from anything.

National Gallery (Slovenian impressionists)
Castle by funicular, Metelkova at night
Saturday central market, Open Kitchen on Fridays
blocks.note: Arrival by night train. Warm; the river and the castle hill are shaded.

Škocjan caves (the underground canyon, UNESCO)
Sečovlje salt pans
Swim at Fiesa

see: Piazza Unità and the Canal Grande
Miramare castle and park
Risiera di San Sabba memorial
Caffè San Marco

see: Anthony's Shaft mine tour

Lace school and a žlikrofi lunch

blocks.name: Lake Bled

see: Pletna boat to the island
Bled castle museum
Vintgar gorge at 8 am

blocks.place: The quiet lake inside Triglav National Park, 1,500–2,000 m day walks
see: Vogel cable car and the ridge walk
Mostnica gorge and the Voje valley

Swim in the lake at 22°C

blocks.name: Triglav Seven Lakes hut-to-hut

see: Up from Savica to the Seven Lakes valley

Down into the Soča side at Trenta if continuing west
blocks.note: Classic and busy on summer weekends; weekdays are fine. Triglav summit itself (2,864 m, via ferrata) is for the siblings only.

blocks.place: Emerald river, Isonzo front museum, Krn lakes
see: Kobarid museum (the Caporetto breakthrough, 1917)

Krn lake walk from Lepena (1,400 m)

blocks.place: Glacial valley, Rinka falls, high farms
see: Logar valley floor to Rinka waterfall
Klemenča jama hut walk
Solčava panoramic road and the hill farms

blocks.name: Velika Planina
blocks.place: Herders' plateau of wooden huts at 1,600 m
see: Cable car then chairlift, walk the plateau
Sour milk and žganci at a herder's hut
Night in a converted hut

notes: Mountain huts fully open; weekends busy with Slovenians, weekdays quiet.
Ljubljana and the coast at 29–31°C; the Alps at 19–24°C.
Afternoon thunderstorms are common in the Julian Alps in July: start walks early.

lodgingAssumption: Local B&B or Airbnb, two rooms for five, one meal out a day; shared van or hire car
